body:
## Why

PR #158 (#156) was merged with two review notes left open. Both are about wording the coordinator reads. Neither makes the agent plan wrong, but both go against what #156 set out to do: name each idea one way, and define the itinerary's terms exactly. Notes are Joe's call (code review design section 3.2), so they're written down here until he decides.

## Design

- [Technical spec](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/technical-spec.md), section 5.2: the coordinator's itinerary section.
- [Tool design](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/tools.md), section 2.4: `compute_route`.

## Items

1. **`compute_route`'s reply says "Drive times".** Its reply still says "Drive times are Google's averages, without the drive buffer." Its description now says "road time", and the coordinator's itinerary section defines "Road time" as the name for this figure. So the coordinator reads a third name for the same numbers. Fix: "Road times are Google's averages, without the drive buffer." ([review note](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/pull/158#discussion_r4383234036))
2. **The "Leg" and "Day" terms don't fit the first and last days.** The "Leg" term says a leg runs "from where the party slept to where it sleeps that night". Day 1's leg starts at the start place, where the party didn't sleep. The last day's leg ends at the end place, where it doesn't sleep. The "Day" term says a day "either moves to a new stay, or stays put", but the last day does neither. Fix, as a starting point: a leg runs "from where the day starts, the start place or a stay, to where it ends, a stay or the end place", and the "Day" term covers the last day too. ([review note](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/pull/158#discussion_r4383234167))

## Open questions

- Fix these on their own, or fold them into #56, which adds to the same itinerary section?

## Do

- Fix both items in the coordinator's instructions (`src/agent/coordinator-prompt.ts`) and `compute_route`'s reply, and change technical spec 5.2 and tool design 2.4 to match.
- Run `npm run agent-views`, and commit the coordinator's view file with the change.

## Done when

- The coordinator's view file shows both fixes.
- `npm run check` passes.

## Ends in

A PR.

**Settled in:** chat.
